source_text: Do not restart the server until the backup is complete.
reference_translation: No reinicies el servidor hasta que se complete la copia de seguridad.
candidate_translation: Reinicia el servidor cuando se complete la copia de seguridad.
notes: Candidate reverses the instruction from wait to restart.

source_text: The patient has no known allergies.
reference_translation: Le patient n'a aucune allergie connue.
candidate_translation: Le patient a des allergies connues.
notes: Candidate drops the negation; safety-critical meaning changes.

source_text: Take one tablet every 8 hours, up to 3 tablets per day.
reference_translation: Nehmen Sie alle 8 Stunden eine Tablette ein, höchstens 3 Tabletten pro Tag.
candidate_translation: Nehmen Sie alle 6 Stunden eine Tablette ein, höchstens 4 Tabletten pro Tag.
notes: Dosage interval and daily maximum both differ.

source_text: The offer is valid through 04/05/2026.
reference_translation: La oferta es válida hasta el 5 de abril de 2026.
candidate_translation: La oferta es válida hasta el 4 de mayo de 2026.
notes: Date format was interpreted differently; source date is intended as MM/DD/YYYY.

source_text: She may submit the form tomorrow.
reference_translation: Elle peut soumettre le formulaire demain.
candidate_translation: Elle doit soumettre le formulaire demain.
notes: Permission was changed to obligation.

source_text: Only managers can approve refunds over $500.
reference_translation: 500ドルを超える返金を承認できるのは管理者のみです。
candidate_translation: 管理者は500ドルを超える返金を承認できます。
notes: Candidate omits the exclusivity conveyed by 'only'.

source_text: The meeting was postponed, not canceled.
reference_translation: Das Treffen wurde verschoben, nicht abgesagt.
candidate_translation: Das Treffen wurde abgesagt.
notes: Candidate changes postponement into cancellation.

source_text: Keep the document out of direct sunlight.
reference_translation: Mantén el documento alejado de la luz solar directa.
candidate_translation: Mantén el documento bajo la luz solar directa.
notes: Candidate reverses the direction of the instruction.

source_text: The package contains 2.5 liters of solution.
reference_translation: Le colis contient 2,5 litres de solution.
candidate_translation: Le colis contient 25 litres de solution.
notes: Decimal separator was lost, changing the quantity by a factor of ten.

source_text: Please call me before you leave.
reference_translation: 出発する前に電話してください。
candidate_translation: 出発した後に電話してください。
notes: Candidate changes before to after.

source_text: He barely passed the exam.
reference_translation: Apenas aprobó el examen.
candidate_translation: Aprobó el examen con facilidad.
notes: Candidate reverses the low margin of passing into an easy pass.

source_text: The customer is not required to provide a phone number.
reference_translation: Der Kunde muss keine Telefonnummer angeben.
candidate_translation: Der Kunde muss eine Telefonnummer angeben.
notes: Candidate reverses an optional field into a requirement.

source_text: Store below 25 °C; do not freeze.
reference_translation: Conserver à une température inférieure à 25 °C ; ne pas congeler.
candidate_translation: Conserver à une température inférieure à 25 °C ; congeler.
notes: Candidate reverses the explicit instruction not to freeze.

source_text: The bank is across from the library.
reference_translation: El banco está frente a la biblioteca.
candidate_translation: El banco está dentro de la biblioteca.
notes: Candidate changes a location opposite the library to inside it.

source_text: Unless the supervisor approves, access remains disabled.
reference_translation: 上司が承認しない限り、アクセスは無効のままです。
candidate_translation: 上司が承認すれば、アクセスは無効のままです。
notes: Candidate changes the condition under which access remains disabled.

source_text: The report covers Q1, excluding March.
reference_translation: Der Bericht umfasst das erste Quartal, ausgenommen März.
candidate_translation: Der Bericht umfasst das erste Quartal einschließlich März.
notes: Candidate reverses the exclusion of March.

source_text: We need fewer than 10 volunteers.
reference_translation: Nous avons besoin de moins de 10 bénévoles.
candidate_translation: Nous avons besoin d'au moins 10 bénévoles.
notes: Candidate changes a strict upper bound to a lower bound.

source_text: The doctor said the test was inconclusive.
reference_translation: El médico dijo que la prueba no era concluyente.
candidate_translation: El médico dijo que la prueba era concluyente.
notes: Candidate omits the negative prefix and changes the finding.

source_text: You can reach the office by 5 p.m.; it closes at 5:30 p.m.
reference_translation: 午後5時までにオフィスに到着できます。閉館は午後5時30分です。
candidate_translation: 午後5時30分までにオフィスに到着できます。閉館は午後5時です。
notes: Candidate swaps the arrival deadline and closing time.

source_text: Although the device is waterproof, it should not be submerged.
reference_translation: Obwohl das Gerät wasserdicht ist, sollte es nicht untergetaucht werden.
candidate_translation: Da das Gerät wasserdicht ist, kann es untergetaucht werden.
notes: Candidate changes contrast to cause and reverses the safety instruction.
